type.description: Data type of the field. Supported types include string, int32, int64, float, bool, string[], int32[], int64[], float[], bool[], auto, object, object[], geopoint, geopoint[], image.

optional.description: Whether this field is optional in documents.

facet.description: Whether this field can be used for faceting.

index.description: Whether this field should be indexed for search.

sort.description: Whether this field can be used for sorting.

infix.description: Whether infix search is enabled for this field.

reference.description: Reference to a field in another collection for JOINs.

num_dim.description: Number of dimensions for vector fields.

store.description: Whether to store the field value for retrieval.

range_index.description: Whether to build a range index for this field.

stem.description: Whether stemming is enabled for this field.

stem_dictionary.description: Name of the custom stemming dictionary to use.

drop.description: Whether to drop this field during a schema update.

embed.description: Embedding configuration for auto-generating vector embeddings.

from.description: Field names to generate embeddings from.

api_key.description: API key for external embedding services.
